text:
maya: Quick unit-econ readout for polaris-lite-9p bring-up (sampled 5k multi-turn chats). TL;DR + a recommended rollout. tagging @arjun @dom @selene.

arjun: drop the headline numbers pls

maya: metrics snapshot:
```
polaris-lite-9p-int6
  p50: 175ms, p95: 410ms
  avg tokens/req: 450
  cost / 1M toks: $18.40
  GTN multi-turn: 0.86

polaris-lite-9p-int4
  p50: 215ms, p95: 670ms
  avg tokens/req: 450
  cost / 1M toks: $10.20
  GTN multi-turn: 0.81
```

dom: rough math => ~44% cheaper int4, ~0.05 GTN drop. where is quality lost?

maya: regressions concentrated on long-context (>800 tokens) multi-turn threads and a few instruction-following few-shot prompts. single-turn Q&A and short summarization look near-parity. hallucination delta is within noise.

selene: product ask: how to present to GTN and control risk for enterprise?

maya: proposed policy:
- mixed-fleet routing: default -> int4; route to int6 when context_tokens > 800 OR user_tier == enterprise OR request flagged high_criticality.
- canary: 5% -> 30% over 14d with shadow logging.
- validation: nightly GTN diff on canary vs control; gating slice = instruction-following few-shot + long-context recall. rollback if GTN delta <= -0.02 or hallucination+failures spike.

arjun: expected unit-econ after routing?

maya: back-of-envelope: all-int6 = $18.40/1M. all-int4 = $10.20/1M. 70% int4 + 30% int6 = ~$12.96/1M (~30% savings). if 20% of traffic pinned to int6 (long contexts) -> ~$14.08/1M (~24% savings).

dom: main risk is rare-slice regression. how long to monitor?

maya: plan: 2w ramp with daily GTN diffs + 48h shadow runs on top-5 product flows. enforce immediate feature-flag rollback.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Created canary flag `polaris-lite-9p-mixed-canary` -> default 5%. Runbook: /run rollout-canary polaris-lite-9p 5% to 30% over 14d.

selene: need one-sentence GTM line for the deck.

maya: GTM sentence: "Polaris-lite-9p int4 reduces per-token cost by ~44% with a small 0.05 GTN-score tradeoff; recommend mixed-fleet routing to achieve ~24–30% overall cost savings while preserving enterprise long-context fidelity."

arjun: please add routing examples to docs and update model page with the perf/quality table.

dom: add the instruction-following few-shot slice as must-pass before increasing beyond 30%.

maya: will add to nightly GTN suite and publish per-slice CSV + short summary to the onboarding doc by EOD. raw samples available on request. :thumbsup:

selene: I'll brief GTN/product and coordinate ops for canary scheduling this afternoon.

maya: follow-ups captured. tagging infra for rollout.

infra-bot: audit: canary flag created by maya at 1721122334.
